factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: The Group generated higher revenue... however, the increase in operating expenses... had a negative impact on the Group’s financial performance. The result for the comparative period was also positively affected by the profit from the disposal of land for the Rail Baltica project and the insurance indemnity received. Cargo volumes decreased... The decline in operating profit was mainly attributable to higher operating expenses... The decline in operating profit was offset by revenue growth...

numerical_claims.claim: AS Tallinna Sadam generated total revenue of EUR 59.3 million, a 2.4 percent increase compared to EUR 57.9 million in the prior year period.
numerical_claims.label: CORRECT
numerical_claims.source_evidence: Revenue for the 6 months ended 30 June 2026: EUR 59,262 thousand (2026) vs EUR 57,862 thousand (2025), representing a 2.4% increase

numerical_claims.claim: Operating expenses rose 24.0 percent to EUR 20.2 million.

numerical_claims.source_evidence: Operating expenses increased by EUR 3.9 million (+24.0%) in the first 6 months of the year

numerical_claims.claim: Operating profit declined by 25.7 percent to EUR 13.6 million, compressing the operating margin to 22.9 percent from 31.6 percent.
numerical_claims.label: CORRECT
numerical_claims.source_evidence: Operating profit for the first 6 months of 2026 decreased by EUR 4.7 million (–25.7%) to EUR 13.6 million... operating profit margin decreased from 31.6% to 22.9%
